methods.label: Check the circle condition
methods.explanation: This theorem holds only in the same circle or in congruent circles, so the statement “Equal central angles subtend equal arcs” is incorrect. In the same circle, equal arcs subtend equal chords and equal central angles.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 9 arc-chord-angle relationship and elementary reasoning about a theorem's conditions.
